overview: Extract CompletedViewModel from CompletedView (181 lines). View manages recently completed tasks with date grouping, un-complete, and delete. VM takes filtering, grouping, and mutation logic.
goals: Create @Observable CompletedViewModel owning 30-day filtering, date grouping, un-complete lifecycle, and deletion
Reduce CompletedView from ~181 lines to ~100 lines
Make un-complete and notification rescheduling testable
nonGoals: No changes to 30-day cutoff or grouping logic
successMetrics: CompletedViewModel.swift created with static compute helpers and mutation methods
Completed tasks grouped and un-complete work identically
rules: View holds @Query, passes tasks to VM via update()
Grouping and label logic as static methods for direct unit testing

stories.title: Create CompletedViewModel with filtering, grouping, mutations
stories.description: Create the ViewModel file with @Observable class, 30-day filtering, date grouping, un-complete, delete, and destination label.
acceptanceCriteria: recentCompletedTasks and groupedTasks with update(tasks:) entry point (1.3)
